tagline: A premier Midwest-based bank focused on disciplined growth and client-driven financial solutions
hero_kpi_rationale: The Net Interest Margin is the primary performance indicator for traditional banks like ONB, reflecting the effectiveness of asset and liability management in a changing interest rate environment. The 3.65% margin in 2025 demonstrates disciplined funding cost management and efficient allocation of earning assets.

kpis.name: Net Interest Margin
kpis.explanation: Difference between interest income earned and borrowing costs, expressed as a percentage of earning assets.
kpis.description: Net Interest Margin improved to 3.65% in Q4 2025, driven by lower funding costs and better earning asset management.
kpis.signal: Margin expanding over the past year, indicating effective rate and liquidity management.

kpis.name: Efficiency Ratio
kpis.explanation: Operating expenses divided by total revenues, the lower the better.
kpis.description: ONB maintains an efficiency ratio of 55.10% in 2025, slightly improved from 55.85% in 2024, despite integration costs related to Bremer.
kpis.signal: Efficiency ratio nearly stable despite the major Bremer integration, demonstrating strong cost control.

kpis.name: Loan Growth
kpis.explanation: Increase in the total volume of loans extended by the bank.
kpis.description: Loan growth reaches 34% in 2025, with 5% organic, the remainder driven by the acquisition of Bremer Bank.
kpis.signal: Exceptional loan growth, fueled by the Bremer acquisition and solid 5% organic growth.

kpis.name: Deposit Growth
kpis.explanation: Increase in total client deposit balances.
kpis.description: Total deposits grow by 35% in 2025, with 5% organic, supported by the Bremer integration and the low-cost franchise.
kpis.signal: Significant deposit growth, driven by the Bremer acquisition and 5% organic growth.

kpis.name: Net Income
kpis.explanation: Profit after all expenses and taxes.
kpis.description: Net income reaches $653.1M in 2025, impacted by $140.9M in merger-related expenses and $75.6M in Day 1 CECL provision. On an adjusted basis, net income reaches $808.6M.
kpis.signal: Net income of $653.1M in 2025, growing despite significant Bremer integration costs.

kpis.name: Tangible Book Value Growth
kpis.explanation: Increase in the real value of assets after liabilities and impairments.
kpis.description: Tangible book value per share increases by 15% in 2025 ($13.71 vs $11.91 in 2024), indicating sustainable value creation for shareholders.
kpis.signal: Strong growth in tangible book value per share, demonstrating value creation for shareholders despite integration.

kpis.name: Loan to Deposit Ratio
kpis.explanation: Proportion of deposits used to fund loans.
kpis.description: The loan to deposit ratio remains stable at 89%, reflecting a balanced approach to lending and stable funding sources, with remaining lending capacity.
kpis.signal: Healthy ratio, indicating sound liquidity and sufficient capacity to fund future growth.

kpis.name: Net Charge-Offs
kpis.explanation: Actual loan losses on uncollected loans, expressed as a percentage of average loans.
kpis.description: Net charge-offs amount to 0.25% of average loans in 2025, slightly higher than 0.17% in 2024, reflecting prudent portfolio management.
kpis.signal: Stable credit quality with slight tightening, reflecting prudent risk management despite integration.

kpis.name: Loan Growth ex M&A
kpis.explanation: Loan growth excluding the impact of acquisitions.
kpis.description: Organic loan growth is 5% in 2025, demonstrating strong client demand and effective commercial execution.
kpis.signal: Solid organic growth, evidence of commercial momentum independent of mergers and integrations.

kpis.name: Deposit Growth ex M&A
kpis.explanation: Deposit growth excluding the impact of acquisitions.
kpis.description: Organic deposit growth reaches 5% in 2025, supported by a low-cost franchise and sustained customer loyalty.
kpis.signal: Ability to attract stable deposits without relying on mergers, confirming the strength of the franchise model.

kpis.name: Dividend Per Share
kpis.explanation: Montant total versé en dividendes par action sur l'année fiscale.

kpis.name: Capital Returned to Shareholders
kpis.explanation: Total annuel : dividendes versés + rachats d'actions.
kpis.description: Cumulative dividends + buybacks (2021-2025) in billions USD. Source yfinance cashflow.

kpis.name: Payout Ratio
kpis.explanation: Part du résultat net redistribuée. >80 % = potentiellement non soutenable.

ai_positioning.summary: No mention of artificial intelligence, AI adoption, or advanced technology solutions in the provided documents. ONB does not position AI as a strategic transformation lever.
evidence: No reference to AI or machine learning technologies in the Business, MD&A, or Risk sections.
No mention of chatbots, intelligent automation, or AI-based analytics tools.
Referenced technology investments remain generic: focus on 'talent, technology, and client facing capabilities' without AI specification.
